items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams suffered hamstring injury; Tyson Bagent replaced him. Imaging scheduled Monday.
items.why: In-game injury confirmed by team; Bagent in.
items.implication: Williams status for Week 3 TBD post-imaging; Bagent stream option short-term.
items.opportunity: Bears pass catchers volume with backup QB; monitor ROS.

items.text: Ladd McConkey is officially ACTIVE for Chargers. RJ Harvey inactive; grab Jonah Coleman if available.
items.why: Official inactive list confirmation after cracked rib and optimism reports.
items.implication: McConkey remains viable WR2 with possible flak jacket/docks; Harvey out opens backup RB work.
items.opportunity: Target share for McConkey if limited; Coleman role expansion.

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey is inactive today due to hamstring.
items.implication: Removes from lineups; elevates backups for carries/snaps.
items.opportunity: Backup RB opportunity increase in Denver backfield.

items.text: Eagles say RB Saquon Barkley (stinger) is questionable to return today.
items.implication: Monitor return; possible limited or backup work.
items.opportunity: If out, Gainwell or other RB snaps.

items.text: Brock Bowers (knee) inactive for Raiders; expected next week possible. Michael Mayer primary TE.
items.why: Official inactives after pregame workout and doubtful tag; Rapoport notes Week 3 return likely.
items.implication: Sit Bowers; start Mayer for TE volume.
items.opportunity: Mayer targets/snaps elevated as primary TE.

items.text: Packers ruled out WR Jayden Reed (neck).
items.implication: Sit Reed; boosts other GB WRs.

items.text: Joe Burrow, listed questionable (back), is officially active vs Texans. Also Olave, McMillan active; Tua inactive.
items.why: Official active list after expected-to-play reports and coach comments.
items.implication: Burrow QB1 lock; Olave full go no docks.
items.opportunity: Full snap/target share for Burrow-Olave connection.

items.text: Nico Collins (hamstring) ruled out for Week 2.
items.implication: Sit Collins; elevates other HOU WRs.
items.opportunity: Target share bump for remaining Texans pass catchers.

items.text: Projecting Ladd McConkey in with decent injury docks; RapSheet tone bullish, status likely ~2:30pm ET. Puka true GTD. Olave clean no docks.
items.why: ETR summary + Rap optimism; projections updating with docks for McConkey, none for Olave.
items.implication: Start McConkey cautiously; full Olave; monitor Puka.
items.opportunity: McConkey routes if active; clean Olave target share.

items.text: Expecting decent look at Jonah Coleman with RJ Harvey doubtful/inactive. Decent look at Germie Bernard with Michael Pittman out.
items.why: Role expansion from teammate absences; usage opportunity.

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) OUT. Michael Pittman (foot) OUT.
items.why: Weekend reports summary confirmed by beat/insiders.
items.implication: Removes from all lineups; opens WR targets in BAL and IND/PIT offenses.

items.text: Sunday AM summary: McConkey GTD optimism+flak, Nacua GTD, Harvey not expected, Olave/Burrow/McMillan expected (snap count), Flowers/Pittman OUT.
items.implication: Key status board for lineup decisions pre-inactives.

items.text: Rams consider Puka Nacua (hip) a pre-game decision for MNF vs Giants; true GTD, trending concerns.
items.implication: Hold/pivot ready for MNF; limited or out possible.
items.opportunity: If out, TE/WR depth bumps in LAR.

items.text: Saints WR Chris Olave (hamstring) expected to play; confirmed active.
items.opportunity: Clean target share no docks per Levitan.

items.text: Ja'Marr Chase holy hell what a catch; proud Fantasy Life investor.
Marshawn Lloyd first career TD; congrats to those who waited.
Agrees with stash of Germie Bernard (Pittman out, good fit for McCarthy offense YAC).
items.implication: Deep league stash for potential targets.
